composition_subtypes.role: iterate intervals in sorted order, pick smallest feasible bridge
maintain available bridges sorted for fast lookup and removal (Fastlist)

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort intervals by left endpoint, then greedy match using a sorted data structure (Fastlist) to pick smallest feasible bridge for each interval.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sorting to order intervals, a custom sorted list to manage bridges, and a greedy loop to assign bridges.
